$comment: Suite manifest: one file to install the trust layer. Every URL and tool name here was checked live on 2026-11-01; nothing is aspirational.

attest.purpose: Verify an artifact before accepting or paying for it: schema, emptiness, provenance, authority.
attest.free_tier: 5 checks per day per address; then 0.005 USDC per call over x402

mitracore.purpose: Mandates and limits (drift layer), cost quote, and a single trust report over the layers.
mitracore.free_tier: 20 checks per day per address; then 0.005 USDC per call over x402

deny.purpose: Signed, append-only journal of refusals: who asked, which policy fired, why.
deny.note: There is no MCP endpoint for the deny journal today. It is an HTTP API with Ed25519-signed records; claiming an MCP tool here would be false.
deny.auth: X-API-Key for paid volume; 20 records per day free per address
